narrative.overview:
A pocket airline timetable read as a rack of opaque panes on a lit bed. A saturated bed colour fills the room: rail, top bar, margins. Work lives in flat panes ruled in 2px, with no radius and no shadow. Everything is set at one size, 15px, so rank is never carried by scale. It is carried by weight, case, a rule, or reversal onto a plate. State is never a coloured pill; it is a mark in a fixed 18px cell that reads the same in every row.

The system is a BD team's operating record, used before a call and right after one. Density is steady and tabular. Condensed uppercase labels, tracked wide, sit over plain gothic prose; numerals are tabular. Each screen carries exactly one reversed plate, which names the page or client.

The look is themeable by construction. Seven themes (Goldenrod default, Paper, Carbon, Slate, Bottle green, Vermilion, Indigo) swap a fixed set of tokens on :root[data-theme]. The grammar never changes.
keyCharacteristics: One type size (15px) everywhere; rank by weight, case, rule, reversal.
Opaque panes on a bed; 2px rules; radius 0; no elevation.
State is a mark in a fixed cell: filled ok, hollow skipped, struck lapsed.
Exactly one reversed plate per screen.

rules.name: The Tokens-Only Rule
rules.body: A theme may change only the 20 named tokens (bed, bed-ink, bed-rule, pane, pane-2, ink, muted, rule, plate, plate-ink, plate-muted, ok, ok-ink, ok-on, bad, bad-ink, bad-on, warn, warn-ink, focus). No component hardcodes a colour.

rules.name: The State-Is-Not-Decoration Rule
rules.body: ok, bad and warn appear only as a state mark, a count, or state text. Never as a panel fill or an accent.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: Every element is 15px (--size). Never add a second size; rank with weight (400, 500, 600), case, a rule, or reversal.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Prose Rule
rules.body: Condensed is uppercase and tracked; where a label holds a sentence (plate subtitle, panel sub, theme note) it reverts to Franklin, no case transform, no tracking.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, no blur, no gradients except the 2px diagonal strike that marks lapsed.

rules.name: The Fixed-Cell Rule
rules.body: State marks are square cells with a 2px border: 18px in chips, 40px in the 12-month strip (32px on phones, 20px in the mini strip), 24px in the timeline. Filled ok means ordered or active. Hollow means skipped or new. A 2px diagonal strike in bad on a bad border means lapsed or quiet. Watch is a hollow cell with a warn inner square.

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: One reversed plate per screen: the page head or client head. Reversal elsewhere is limited to the primary button, a pressed toggle/segment, the Add tab, the AI source tag, and the current wizard step.

rules.name: The Same Grammar Rule
rules.body: A new theme is a new set of values for the 20 tokens and an entry in lib/themes.js. It never introduces a component rule.

dos: Do set all text at 15px and rank by weight, case, rule, or reversal.
Do use 2px rules and 0 radius on every pane, control and menu.
Do show state as a mark in a fixed cell: filled ok, hollow skipped, struck lapsed.
Do put one reversed plate on each screen.
Do reference tokens (var(--pane), var(--rule)) and test a new surface in at least Goldenrod and Carbon.
Do keep tabular numerals for counts, dates and totals.
donts: Don't use grey SaaS cards, big KPI numbers, display type, or gradients.
Don't add a second type size, a radius, or a drop shadow.
Don't colour a panel with ok, bad or warn; they mark state only.
Don't put a literal colour in a component; add or change a theme token instead.
Don't give a theme its own component rule.
